[P2] Match the subtype migration to the implemented API

The reviewed source still defines `OperationSubType` as an ordinary `Enum`, requires `sub_type` in all three context-update factories, and provides no `sub_type` argument on `StepConfig` or `CallbackConfig`. This PR does not change those implementations. Following these instructions therefore introduces `TypeError`s, while removing `.value` leaves enum objects where consumers expect strings. Rewrite this section for the actual release API, or include the subtype implementation and its tests before advertising this migration.
